This procedure is considered as a minor maintenance P1. It
should be done every year Y1 in addition to activities mentioned in the
daily/weekly Inspection documents.

items:
A work permit must be issued, qualified 
 maintenance staff carry the suitable safety ID category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,

Wear standard personal safety and healthy equipment as helmet, safety shoes, 
 rubber gloves, ... etc.

Before doing maintenance, inspection, or service work on the unit be sure
 that the starting switch is in OFF position to prevent the unit from
 accidentally starting.

Do not throw the sump oil to the sewage because this oil will prevent the
 sewage treatment process. Collect it in tight containers and return it back
 to the vendor to recycle it. Always remember that "This oil is load for
 your wastes but it's valuable material for them."

Avoid oil spillage to the ground because this oil spillage has very bad
 impact on the environment.

Using solvents such as gasoline and others for cleaning the 1st, 2d, and 3rd
 stage of air Head, and Valve, Inlet Air Filter will expose lungs to very
 hazardous and carcinogenic chemicals. You have to wear your breathing mask.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.

Fix any oil leaks to prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil. Oil
 leaks to the ground have very bad impacts on environment, mainly on soil and
 ground water and eventually on the ecosystem. "It takes only 1 liter of
 Hydrocarbon spilled in an aquifer to render 1,000,000 liters of
 potable water useless for human consumption".
Tool set, Cloth,
Sodium Hydroxide Solution, Benzene,
New air filter cartridge,
Grinding Past, gasket set,
Open the oil drain plug to drain the oil out of the sump (figure 2).
Disassemble inlet air filter (figure 1).

Disassemble 1st stage inlet manifold (figures 1, 2) one bolt Use spanner
 19.
Disassemble 1st stage discharge manifold (figure 2).
Disassemble 2nd stage inlet manifold.
Disassemble 2nd stage discharge manifold.
Disassemble 3rd stage discharge manifold.

sections.text: First Stage Air Head and Valve (fig 3)

items:
Unscrew the six cap screws no.s 4 & 5 of the first stage air head. Use
 spanner 19
Pullout the air head and the entire valve.

Unscrew the two nuts no. 6 of studs no.14 to disassemble the valve from
 the air head.
Disassemble the entire valve by unscrewing the two machine screws no. 11.

Clean the parts of the valve from part no. 7 to part no.14 in figure 3
 using benzene and dry it.
Check all parts of the valve and change any part if needed.
Change the two gaskets no. 2 & 3.
Reassemble the entire valve to the air head.

Repeat all the previous to make maintenance to the other unit of the first
 stage air head and valve.

sections.text: Second Stage Air Head and Valve (Figure 5)

items:
Repeat all the previous steps1: 8 (First stage air head and valve) to
 make maintenance to the second stage air head and valve (the second stage as
 the same of the first stage) except that there is a metal ring with
 calibrated thickness between the valve and cylinder incase of canceling the
 forth stage clean it and reassemble it again. Use spanner 14

sections.text: Third Stage Air Head and Valve (Figure 7)

items:
Unscrew the six cap screws no. 3 of the air head and pull out the air
 head. Use spanner 19
Pull out the entire valve.
Unscrew the two screws socket head of the third stage no. 7 figure 7.
Check and clean all valves parts from no.4 to no.11 fig.7 with benzine

Make smoothing to the valve seat no.5 inlet valve plate no.10 and
 discharge valve plate no.8 using fine grinding past and clean all parts with
 benzine and dry it.
Change O-ring no. 2.
Reassemble the entire valve of the third stage

sections.text: Fourth Stage Air Head and Valve (figure 9) If exist

items: Unscrew the four cap screws no. 4.
Pull out the entire valve.
Check and clean all parts from part no. 2 to 13.
Change air head gaskets no. 2, O-rings no. 3 and copper washer no. 11.
Change any part (if needed).
Reassemble the entire valve.
Reassemble all stages in their original position on the cylinder.
Unscrew the nut of its cover.

Clean the filter element no. 3 with flow of air and benzine and dry it
 with flow of air or replace it if needed.

Clean the oil bowl no. 4 with benzine and refill with new oil to its
 correct level.
Reassemble the inlet air filter in its place.

Disassemble the oil filter set (figure 14) and clean its
 parts and change oil filter element no.5 figure 14.

Unscrew the separator for the four stages no. 1,7,13,15 clean with benzine
 , dry with flow of air and replace it if needed.
Clean and inspect for damaged fins for radiator.

Clean the radiator tubes with flow of Sodium Hydroxide Solution,water and
 dry it with flow of air.
Reassemble the separator.

Introduction
This procedure is considered as a minor maintenance P1. It
should be done every year Y1 in addition to activities mentioned in the
daily/weekly Inspection documents.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified 
 maintenance staff carry the suitable safety ID category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Wear standard personal safety and healthy equipment as helmet, safety shoes, 
 rubber gloves, ... etc.
Before doing maintenance, inspection, or service work on the unit be sure
 that the starting switch is in OFF position to prevent the unit from
 accidentally starting.
Environmental Recommendation
Do not throw the sump oil to the sewage because this oil will prevent the
 sewage treatment process. Collect it in tight containers and return it back
 to the vendor to recycle it. Always remember that "This oil is load for
 your wastes but it's valuable material for them."
Avoid oil spillage to the ground because this oil spillage has very bad
 impact on the environment.
Using solvents such as gasoline and others for cleaning the 1st, 2d, and 3rd
 stage of air Head, and Valve, Inlet Air Filter will expose lungs to very
 hazardous and carcinogenic chemicals. You have to wear your breathing mask.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.
Fix any oil leaks to prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil. Oil
 leaks to the ground have very bad impacts on environment, mainly on soil and
 ground water and eventually on the ecosystem. "It takes only 1 liter of
 Hydrocarbon spilled in an aquifer to render 1,000,000 liters of
 potable water useless for human consumption".
Tools and Equipment
Tool set, Cloth,
Sodium Hydroxide Solution, Benzene,
New air filter cartridge,
Grinding Past, gasket set,

Fourth Stage Air Head and Valve (figure 9) If exist

Check and clean all parts from part no. 2 to 13.

Inlet Air Filter (figure 13)
Unscrew the nut of its cover.
Clean the filter element no. 3 with flow of air and benzine and dry it

Clean the oil bowl no. 4 with benzine and refill with new oil to its

Oil Filter (Figure 14)
Disassemble the oil filter set (figure 14) and clean its

Radiators (Figure 16)
